exact_held_quotes.quote:
A dispute exists between The Long Island Rail Road and certain of its 
employees represented by Participating Labor Organizations designated in list 
attached hereto and made a part hereof.

1-101. Establishm ent o f Board. There is established a board of three members 
to be appointed by the President to investigate this dispute. No member of the 
board shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of 
railroad employees or any carrier.

1-102. Report. The board shall report its finding to the President with respect 
to the dispute within 30 days from the date of this Order.

1-103. M aintaining Conditions. As provided by Section 10 of the Railway 
Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for 30 days after the board has 
made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be 
made by The Long Island Rail Road, or by its employees, in the conditions out 
of which the dispute arose.

Participating Labor Organizations
International Brotherhood of Teamsters (IBT)
United Transportation Union (UTU)
Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers (BLE)
Brotherhood of Railroad Carmen (BRC)
Brotherhood of Railroad Signalmen (BRS)
Railroad Yardmasters of America (RYA)
Police Benevolent Association (PBA)

Sec. 7. Executive Order No. 12182, creating an Em ergency Board to Investigate  
a Dispute Betw een the Long Island Rail Road and Certain of Its Employees, is  
revoked.

distinct_commands: establish three-member board to investigate this dispute
report within 30 days from order date
maintain conditions until 30 days after actual report, subject to agreement
original_inventory.annex_significance: Seven participating organizations define the dispute and covered employees. The annex is incorporated by the preamble and must be retained in the original inventory; it is not seven independent commands.

independent_findings: The report deadline is not an actual-report occurrence and cannot supply a first-end date.

The no-change directive depends on actual report plus 30 days. The exception permits agreed changes; neither an agreement nor an extension is presumed, and an agreement is not automatically whole-board dissolution.
Complete EO12379 section 7 revokes EO12182 on 1982-08-17, without a delayed effective date or target saving. Its inactive-or-no-longer-necessary recital does not establish first cessation.

The original references Railway Labor Act section 10 (45 USC 160). That historical controlling statutory text was not found/read as a separately held statute in the inspected source manifests; independently statutory effects are not extinguished merely by revoking an EO.

The full named-party matches do not supply an actual report date for this 1979 board. Later boards have express creation events under section 9A with different 120-day or second-board periods; those terms must not be imported into EO12182.

EO12899 explicitly identifies a completed report of EO12874; EO13663 identifies EO13654; EO14374 identifies EO14349. Those are genuine report/termination recitals for their named later boards, not evidence of the EO12182 report.
Later records-maintenance provisions concern the later boards. They do not create a residual records command in the original EO12182.

named_scope_search.function_screen: Long Island party hits were examined for emergency-board establishment, investigation/report, no-change, agreement and termination provisions. All post-original Long Island matches were read in full, not merely titles.

exclusions.pre_creation: Earlier EO rosters and Long Island disputes preceded this 1979 board. No earlier EO is treated as a later ending instrument.
exclusions.same_union_different_carrier: Post-original union-only results were screened by actual titles and party descriptions: national-carrier boards, SEPTA/DTA, NJ Transit, Conrail, PATH, Chicago North Western, Amtrak, Soo Line and Metro North. No Long Island party hit occurs in those normalized texts; shared union names do not establish a change to this board. This is screening, not a full read of every unrelated order.
exclusions.other_corpora: Source-ladder 12491/12492 duplicates concern later Long Island boards whose complete originals were read. 9770 and 1947 coal-supply notices predate this board. Opus 53de... concerns 1946 possession termination; a994.../f57d... concern 1970 labor legislation; 6c90... is 1948 railroad organization text. These are not 1979 board report evidence.

named_scope_search.conclusion: No material earlier cessation found within bounded held search. No search exhaustion or completeness beyond stated corpora claimed.
